entities.name: Economic Recovery and Diversification
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Grenada's long recovery from Hurricane Ivan, the replanting of nutmeg groves, development of tourism (particularly eco-tourism and the underwater sculpture park), and efforts to diversify beyond traditional agriculture and tourism.
